performance.verdict: Campaigns fully dark 13 days; organic holding but leads gone.

findings.text: All paid spend has been $0 since 2026-08-06 — 13 consecutive zero-spend days, producing zero leads vs. 28-day CPL baseline of $24.88.
3-day trend (Aug 16–18): spend $0, leads 0, vs. prior 3-day active window (Aug 4–6) spend $144.92 and 8 leads — full stop, not a dip.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 over Aug 16–18, down from a 28-day average of ~5.6/day — organic floor disappearing alongside paid.
GHL pipeline shows 32 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — 44 leads over 28 days are not converting into pipeline at all.
GA4 sessions spiked to 206 on 2026-08-13 and remain directionally elevated (avg ~58 last 5 active days) despite zero paid spend — source unknown, treat directionally only.

suggestions.text: Confirm why Meta campaigns paused Aug 6; restore 'CROA || CBO - 3/17/26' at last active daily budget (~$70/day) immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: Campaigns have been fully dark since 2026-08-06 with $0 spend across 13 days, eliminating all lead volume (28-day CPL was $24.88). First step is to diagnose the pause reason — budget exhaustion, policy flag, or manual pause — before reactivating. Relaunch 'CROA || CBO - 3/17/26' at ~$70/day (last confirmed active daily rate) and do not scale until CPL returns to the $24.88 baseline or better. Confirm leads are flowing again by 2026-08-22.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 44 leads in 28 days produced 0 opportunities — identify where leads are dropping out of the pipeline.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 32 contacts but zero opportunities created and zero appointments across the 28-day window, despite 44 Meta-attributed leads. This is an intake leak, not an ads problem — leads are arriving but not being converted into pipeline stages. Review GHL workflow triggers, lead assignment rules, and contact-to-opportunity automation to find the drop-off point. Target at least 1 opportunity created per 5 leads within 7 days of campaign reactivation as the success check.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP recovery: actions were 0 for Aug 16–18; re-check after 3 days of paid activity to separate organic drift from paid halo loss.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 over Aug 16–18 against a 28-day average of ~5.6 actions/day. It is unclear whether this is organic softening or a halo effect lost when paid went dark. Re-check GBP action volume on 2026-08-22 after Meta campaigns are restored to determine if recovery tracks with paid reactivation. If GBP remains at 0 after 3 days of active paid spend, escalate as an independent organic issue.
